question: List the names of all artists.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM chinook.artist ORDER BY artist_id;

question: How many tracks are on each album?
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, COUNT(track.track_id) AS track_count FROM chinook.album AS album LEFT JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY album.album_id, album.title ORDER BY album.album_id;

question: How many artists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM chinook.artist;

question: How many albums does each artist have?
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, COUNT(album.album_id) AS album_count FROM chinook.artist AS artist LEFT JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id GROUP BY artist.artist_id, artist.name ORDER BY artist.artist_id;

question: Show the three longest tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT name, milliseconds FROM chinook.track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List every artist ID and name in artist ID order.
gold_sql: SELECT artist_id, name FROM chinook.artist ORDER BY artist_id;

question: List the albums whose titles begin with the letter B.
gold_sql: SELECT album_id, title FROM chinook.album WHERE title LIKE 'B%' ORDER BY album_id;

question: List tracks longer than five minutes, longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, milliseconds FROM chinook.track WHERE milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY milliseconds DESC, track_id;

question: List the names of tracks priced at 0.99 in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM chinook.track WHERE unit_price = 0.99 ORDER BY name;

question: Show all album titles in reverse alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM chinook.album ORDER BY title DESC;

question: List the artists whose names start with A.
gold_sql: SELECT artist_id, name FROM chinook.artist WHERE name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY name, artist_id;

question: Show each artist name alongside the titles of their albums.
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, album.title FROM chinook.artist AS artist JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id ORDER BY artist.artist_id, album.album_id;

question: List each album title with the names of its tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, track.name FROM chinook.album AS album JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id ORDER BY album.album_id, track.track_id;

question: Which albums belong to the artist Accept?
gold_sql: SELECT album.title FROM chinook.artist AS artist JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id WHERE artist.name = 'Accept' ORDER BY album.album_id;

question: List album titles and track names for tracks longer than five minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, track.name FROM chinook.album AS album JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id WHERE track.milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY track.milliseconds DESC, track.track_id;

question: List track names, their album titles, and prices for tracks costing less than one dollar.
gold_sql: SELECT track.name, album.title, track.unit_price FROM chinook.track AS track JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.album_id = track.album_id WHERE track.unit_price < 1.00 ORDER BY track.name, track.track_id;

question: List every artist, album, and track name in hierarchy order.
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name AS artist_name, album.title AS album_title, track.name AS track_name FROM chinook.artist AS artist JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id ORDER BY artist.artist_id, album.album_id, track.track_id;

question: List the tracks recorded by Accept with their album titles.
gold_sql: SELECT track.name, album.title FROM chinook.artist AS artist JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id WHERE artist.name = 'Accept' ORDER BY album.album_id, track.track_id;

question: List artists and albums for tracks longer than five minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, album.title, track.name AS track_name FROM chinook.artist AS artist JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id WHERE track.milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY track.milliseconds DESC, track.track_id;

question: How many tracks does each artist have?
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, COUNT(track.track_id) AS track_count FROM chinook.artist AS artist LEFT JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id LEFT JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY artist.artist_id, artist.name ORDER BY artist.artist_id;

question: What is the total duration in milliseconds of tracks on each album?
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, SUM(track.milliseconds) AS total_milliseconds FROM chinook.album AS album LEFT JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY album.album_id, album.title ORDER BY album.album_id;

question: What is the average track duration for each album?
gold_sql: SELECT album.title, AVG(track.milliseconds) AS average_milliseconds FROM chinook.album AS album LEFT JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY album.album_id, album.title ORDER BY album.album_id;

question: What is the average track price for each artist?
gold_sql: SELECT artist.name, AVG(track.unit_price) AS average_price FROM chinook.artist AS artist LEFT JOIN chinook.album AS album ON album.artist_id = artist.artist_id LEFT JOIN chinook.track AS track ON track.album_id = album.album_id GROUP BY artist.artist_id, artist.name ORDER BY artist.artist_id;
